name: Reputation & Grievances
description: Every attitude change a scenario package makes between two empires (espionage crises, defecting agents, diaspora diplomacy, nationalised charters, the Exchange's exposure) is kept as a ledger entry with its cause, size and yearly fade; the empires' attitude is the same sum, and the diplomacy screen shows why each empire feels the way it does. Includes the Emergent Galaxy packages (their own flags).
